course.title: Mobility and Flexibility
course.tagline: Move freely without pain: stretches and mobility drills for every day.

days.title: What is mobility?
days.goal: Learn what mobility means and why it matters.

video.title: Start Here: Complete 30 Minute Beginner Mobility (WIth Coaching)

steps: Watch the video and write what mobility means in your own words.
Mobility is how well your joints move.
Flexibility is how far your muscles can stretch.
Write down 3 joints: hips, shoulders, ankles.
days.task: Write what mobility and flexibility mean.
days.challenge: Name 3 joints you use every day.

quiz.explain: Mobility is joint movement.

options: How far your muscles can stretch
quiz.explain: Flexibility is muscle stretch.

options: It helps you move freely without pain
quiz.explain: Good mobility means free, painless movement.

days.title: Warm up your joints
days.goal: Learn a joint warm-up you can do every morning.

video.title: 15 Moves to Replace Your ENTIRE Mobility Routine

steps: Roll your neck slowly in a circle, 5 times each way.
Roll your shoulders back 10 times.
Circle your hips 10 times each way.
Circle your ankles 10 times each way.
days.task: Do the joint warm-up this morning.
days.challenge: Do it every morning this week.

options: It wakes them up and eases stiffness
quiz.explain: A joint warm-up eases morning stiffness.
Smooth circles are safe.

quiz.q: How many circles should you do?
quiz.explain: Ten circles wake the joint up.

days.title: Stretch your neck and shoulders
days.goal: Learn gentle stretches for the neck and shoulders.

video.title: 15 Minutes to Wake Up Your Joints

steps: Tilt your head to one side, hold 20 seconds, switch.
Roll your shoulders back 10 times.
Reach one arm across your chest, hold 20 seconds.
Breathe slowly through each stretch.
days.task: Do the neck and shoulder stretches today.
days.challenge: Do them after sitting for a long time.

quiz.q: How long should you hold a stretch?
quiz.explain: Twenty seconds lets the muscle relax.

options: Sitting and phones make it tight
quiz.explain: Neck stretches undo tightness.
A gentle pull is the right feeling.

days.title: Open your hips: butterfly
days.goal: Learn the butterfly stretch for your hips.

video.title: Full-Body Mobility & Stretching | Complete Follow-Along

steps: Sit with the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet and let your knees drop toward the floor.
Sit tall and breathe slowly.
Hold for 30 seconds.
days.task: Hold the butterfly for 30 seconds.
days.challenge: Hold it for 1 minute tomorrow.

options: Sitting with feet together and knees out
quiz.explain: Butterfly opens the hips gently.
Letting knees drop gently stretches the hips.

quiz.q: Why sit tall in a butterfly?
quiz.explain: A tall back protects the spine.

days.title: Stretch your hamstrings
days.goal: Learn two easy stretches for the backs of your legs.

video.title: Primal 7 Flexibility Program

steps: Sit with legs out and reach toward your toes.
Stand and fold forward with bent knees.
Hold each stretch for 30 seconds.
Keep your back long, not rounded hard.
days.task: Do both hamstring stretches for 30 seconds.
days.challenge: Reach a little further each week.

options: The muscles at the back of your thighs
quiz.explain: Hamstrings run down the back of the thigh.

quiz.q: Why keep knees bent in a forward fold?
quiz.explain: Bent knees keep the back safe.
A gentle pull is right.

days.title: Wake up your spine
days.goal: Learn gentle moves for a stiff back.

video.title: Daily Stretch Routine in 10 Minutes

steps: Try cat-cow: on hands and knees, arch and round your back slowly.
Do it 10 times, breathing slowly.
Try a gentle twist sitting in a chair.
Hold the twist for 20 seconds each side.
days.task: Do cat-cow 10 times today.
days.challenge: Do the chair twist each side for 20 seconds.

options: Arching and rounding the back on hands and knees
quiz.explain: Cat-cow gently moves the spine.
Cat-cow should feel like a gentle stretch.

options: It stretches the spine and eases stiffness
quiz.explain: Gentle twists keep the spine mobile.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 1: Your morning mobility routine
days.goal: Put week 1 together: build a 10-minute morning routine.

video.title: Improve Your Body Flexibility and Posture with These 15 Exercises

steps: Pick 5 moves: neck circles, shoulder rolls, hip circles, butterfly, cat-cow.
Do each move for 1 to 2 minutes.
Do the routine every morning.
Write down how you felt after.
days.task: Write your morning routine and do it tomorrow.
days.challenge: Do it every morning this week.

quiz.q: What should a morning routine have?
options: 5 gentle moves for joints and muscles
quiz.explain: A morning routine wakes the body up.
Ten minutes is enough to start the day.
Daily moves keep joints free.

project.title: Your morning mobility routine
project.brief: Build a 10-minute morning routine with 5 moves: neck circles, shoulder rolls, hip circles, butterfly and cat-cow, and do it every morning.

days.title: Stretch your calves and ankles
days.goal: Learn stretches for the lower legs.

video.title: 15-Min Full-Body Stretching Routine

steps: Step one foot back and press the heel down, hold 20 seconds.
Bend the back knee a little and hold again.
Circle each ankle 10 times.
Do both legs.
days.task: Do the calf stretches on each leg.
days.challenge: Circle each ankle 10 times.

options: Tight calves make walking and running hard
quiz.explain: Calf stretches keep walking easy.

quiz.q: What should your heel do in a calf stretch?
quiz.explain: Heel down stretches the calf.

options: It keeps them mobile and strong
quiz.explain: Ankle circles keep the joint free.

days.title: Open your chest
days.goal: Learn a stretch that opens a tight chest.

video.title: Unlock Your Body: 45-minute Full Body Flexibility Workout for Beginners

steps: Clasp your hands behind your back.
Lift your hands gently and open your chest.
Hold for 20 seconds and breathe slowly.
Do it 3 times.
days.task: Do the chest opener 3 times today.
days.challenge: Do it after sitting for a long time.

options: Sitting a lot makes the chest tight
quiz.explain: Chest stretches undo tightness from sitting.
A relaxed neck keeps the stretch safe.

quiz.q: How long should you hold it?
quiz.explain: Twenty seconds is enough.

days.title: Hip mobility: 90/90
days.goal: Learn the 90/90 hip stretch.

video.title: 15 Minute Full Body Gentle Stretching Routine

steps: Sit with one leg in front, knee bent at 90 degrees.
Put the other leg behind you, knee bent at 90 degrees.
Sit tall and hold for 30 seconds.
Switch sides.
days.task: Hold 90/90 for 30 seconds each side.
days.challenge: Hold it for 1 minute each side tomorrow.

options: A hip stretch with both knees bent at 90 degrees
quiz.explain: Ninety-ninety opens the hips.

options: It stretches both sides of the hip
quiz.explain: It works the hip in two directions.
Sitting tall keeps the stretch safe.

days.title: Stretch your quads
days.goal: Learn a stretch for the front of your thighs.

video.title: 90/90 Internal Rotation Lifts

steps: Stand and hold a chair for balance.
Bend one knee and hold your foot behind you.
Keep your knees together and your belly tight.
Hold for 20 seconds each leg.
days.task: Do the quad stretch on each leg.
days.challenge: Do it after walking or running.

options: The muscles at the front of your thighs
quiz.explain: Quads run down the front of the thigh.
A chair keeps you steady.
Knees together stretch the quad evenly.

days.title: Full-body stretch routine
days.goal: Put your stretches into a 15-minute routine.

video.title: 6 Must-Do Exercises for Hip Pain and Mobility

steps: Stretch neck, shoulders, chest, hips, hamstrings and calves.
Hold each stretch for 20 to 30 seconds.
Breathe slowly through each one.
End with 1 minute of slow breathing.
days.task: Do the full-body stretch routine today.
days.challenge: Do it 3 times this week.

quiz.q: What should a full-body routine cover?
quiz.explain: A full routine covers the whole body.

quiz.q: How long should each stretch be?
quiz.explain: Twenty to thirty seconds relaxes the muscle.

quiz.q: What should you do at the end?
quiz.explain: Slow breathing settles the body.

days.title: Mobility for your back
days.goal: Learn moves that keep your back moving well.

video.title: Fix Your Stiff Hips

steps: Do cat-cow 10 times.
Do a gentle twist lying on your back.
Do child's pose for 1 minute.
Move slowly and never force anything.
days.task: Do the back routine today.
days.challenge: Do it every morning this week.

quiz.q: Why move your back gently every day?
options: It keeps the spine mobile and eases stiffness
quiz.explain: Daily gentle moves keep the back healthy.

quiz.q: What should you do if your back hurts?
quiz.explain: Gentle moves or rest keep a sore back safe.

quiz.q: What is child's pose good for?
quiz.explain: Child's pose rests and stretches the back.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 2: Your 15-minute stretch routine
days.goal: Put week 2 together: build your own 15-minute routine.

video.title: Feel Looser & Improve Hip Mobility in Bed

steps: Pick 6 stretches you know and write them in order.
Hold each for 30 seconds.
Add slow breathing at the end.
Do the routine and time it.
days.task: Write your routine and do it today.
days.challenge: Do your routine 3 times this week.

quiz.explain: A full routine covers the body and calms the mind.

quiz.q: How long should each stretch be?
quiz.explain: Thirty seconds relaxes the muscle.

options: So you know it fits in 15 minutes
quiz.explain: Timing keeps the routine practical.

project.title: Your 15-minute stretch routine
project.brief: Build your own 15-minute stretch routine with 6 stretches, 30 seconds each, and slow breathing at the end.

days.title: Fix stiff hips
days.goal: Learn 3 moves that loosen stiff hips.

video.title: Start Here: Complete 30 Minute Beginner Mobility (WIth Coaching)

steps: Do a low lunge: step forward, back knee down, hold 30 seconds.
Do a butterfly stretch for 30 seconds.
Do hip circles standing, 10 times each way.
Do both sides.
days.task: Do all 3 hip moves today.
days.challenge: Do them every day this week.

quiz.explain: Sitting tightens hips; moving loosens them.

options: Stepping forward with the back knee down
quiz.explain: A low lunge stretches the hip flexors.

quiz.q: How often should you do hip moves?
quiz.explain: Daily hip moves keep them free.

days.title: Shoulder mobility
days.goal: Learn moves that free up tight shoulders.

video.title: 15 Moves to Replace Your ENTIRE Mobility Routine

steps: Roll your shoulders back 10 times.
Reach one arm up and bend it behind your head.
Use the other hand to gently pull the elbow.
Hold for 20 seconds each arm.
days.task: Do the shoulder moves today.
days.challenge: Do them after sitting at a desk.

options: Sitting and phone use tighten them
quiz.explain: Sitting tightens shoulders; moving frees them.

quiz.q: What should you do with your elbow?
options: Gently pull it with the other hand
quiz.explain: A gentle pull stretches the shoulder.
A gentle pull is right.

days.title: Ankle mobility for walking
days.goal: Learn moves that keep your ankles free.

video.title: 15 Minutes to Wake Up Your Joints

steps: Circle each ankle 10 times each way.
Kneel and sit back on your heels gently.
Stand and rise on your toes 10 times.
Walk on your heels for 10 steps.
days.task: Do the ankle moves today.
days.challenge: Do them before walking or running.

options: Stiff ankles change how you walk
quiz.explain: Free ankles keep walking smooth.

quiz.q: What is a good ankle move?
quiz.explain: Ankle circles keep the joint free.

options: It strengthens the calves and ankles
quiz.explain: Toe rises build ankle strength.

days.title: Stretch before bed
days.goal: Learn a gentle evening stretch routine.

video.title: Full-Body Mobility & Stretching | Complete Follow-Along

steps: Do a slow forward fold with bent knees.
Rest in child's pose for 2 minutes.
Stretch your arms up and breathe out.
Do this for 5 minutes before bed.
days.task: Do the evening stretches tonight.
days.challenge: Do them every night this week.

options: It relaxes the body for sleep
quiz.explain: Gentle stretches ease the body into sleep.

quiz.q: What is a good bedtime stretch?
quiz.explain: Child's pose is calm and restful.

quiz.q: How long should the routine be?
quiz.explain: Five minutes is enough to relax.

days.title: Test your flexibility
days.goal: Test how far you can reach and how your joints move.

video.title: Primal 7 Flexibility Program

steps: Sit and reach toward your toes: how far can you reach?
Raise your arms above your head: can they go straight up?
Squat down: can your heels stay on the floor?
Write all three results down.
days.task: Record your 3 test results today.
days.challenge: Test again in 2 weeks.

options: To see how much you have improved
quiz.explain: Tests show progress.

quiz.q: What does a sit-and-reach test show?
quiz.explain: Sit-and-reach shows hamstring flexibility.
Two weeks apart shows real change.

days.title: Mobility for work: desk stretches
days.goal: Learn stretches you can do at a desk.

video.title: Daily Stretch Routine in 10 Minutes

steps: Roll your shoulders every hour.
Stretch your neck side to side.
Stand up and stretch your arms up.
Walk for 2 minutes every hour.
days.task: Do a desk stretch every hour today.
days.challenge: Stand up once an hour today.

options: Sitting all day tightens the body
quiz.explain: Desk stretches undo sitting stiffness.

quiz.q: How often should you stand up?
quiz.explain: Standing once an hour breaks up sitting.

quiz.q: What is a good desk stretch?
quiz.explain: Shoulder rolls are quick and easy.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 3: Your daily mobility plan
days.goal: Put week 3 together: build a daily mobility plan.

video.title: Improve Your Body Flexibility and Posture with These 15 Exercises

steps: Morning: 10-minute joint warm-up.
Midday: desk stretches every hour.
Evening: 5-minute stretch before bed.
Follow the plan for 7 days.
days.task: Write your daily mobility plan.
days.challenge: Follow it for 7 days.

quiz.q: What should a daily plan have?
quiz.explain: Small moves through the day keep you mobile.

options: A week shows if the plan works
quiz.explain: A week of practice shows real change.

quiz.q: What should you do if a day goes badly?
quiz.explain: One bad day does not ruin the plan.

project.title: Your daily mobility plan
project.brief: Build a daily plan: a 10-minute morning warm-up, desk stretches every hour, and a 5-minute evening stretch, and follow it for 7 days.

days.title: Teach a friend to stretch
days.goal: Teach someone else your favourite stretches.

video.title: 15-Min Full-Body Stretching Routine

steps: Show them the butterfly stretch.
Show them the chest opener.
Show them cat-cow.
Ask them how they felt after.
days.task: Teach one stretch to a friend.
days.challenge: Teach all 3 stretches this week.

options: Teaching helps you learn it better
quiz.explain: Teaching locks in your own learning.

quiz.q: What is the first stretch to teach?
quiz.explain: Butterfly is simple and feels good.

options: So you know if the stretch helped
quiz.explain: Feedback shows what works.

days.title: Review your month
days.goal: Look back at your month of mobility work.

video.title: Unlock Your Body: 45-minute Full Body Flexibility Workout for Beginners

steps: Read your notes from weeks 1 to 3.
List 3 things that got easier.
List 1 thing that is still hard.
Write one fix for the hard thing.
days.task: List 3 things that got easier.
days.challenge: Fix one hard thing in your plan.

options: To see what got easier and what needs fixing
quiz.explain: Reviewing shows real progress.

quiz.q: What should you do with a hard thing?
options: Fix it with one small change
quiz.explain: One small fix keeps the plan going.

quiz.q: What is a sign mobility is better?
options: You move more freely with less stiffness
quiz.explain: Freer movement means it works.

days.title: Keep moving for life
days.goal: Make mobility a habit for life.

video.title: 15 Minute Full Body Gentle Stretching Routine

steps: Do your morning routine every day.
Stretch at your desk every hour.
Stretch before bed every night.
Check your flexibility once a month.
days.task: Do your morning routine tomorrow.
days.challenge: Check your flexibility once this month.

quiz.q: How do you keep mobility for life?
quiz.explain: Daily small moves keep joints free.
Monthly checks catch problems early.

quiz.q: What is the best mobility habit?
quiz.explain: Short daily moves beat rare long ones.

days.title: Stretch your wrists and hands
days.goal: Learn stretches for wrists and hands.

video.title: 90/90 Internal Rotation Lifts

steps: Hold one arm out and pull the fingers back gently.
Hold for 20 seconds.
Press your palms together and lower them.
Make fists and open your hands 10 times.
Circle your wrists 10 times each way.
Do both hands.
days.task: Do the wrist stretches today.
days.challenge: Do them every hour at your desk.

options: Typing and phone use make them tight
quiz.explain: Wrist stretches undo tightness from typing.

quiz.q: How long should you hold a wrist stretch?
quiz.explain: Twenty seconds lets the muscle relax.

quiz.q: What should you do with your fingers?
quiz.explain: A gentle pull stretches the wrist safely.

days.title: Mobility for your knees
days.goal: Learn gentle moves that keep knees moving well.

video.title: 6 Must-Do Exercises for Hip Pain and Mobility

steps: Sit and straighten one leg, hold 5 seconds.
Bend and straighten the knee 10 times.
Stand and do small squats, only as far as comfortable.
Circle your knees gently.
Never push through sharp pain.
Do both legs.
days.task: Do the knee moves today.
days.challenge: Do them every day this week.

quiz.q: Why move your knees gently every day?
options: It keeps them strong and mobile
quiz.explain: Daily gentle moves keep knees healthy.

quiz.q: What should you do if a knee hurts sharply?
quiz.explain: Sharp pain means stop.
Comfortable depth keeps knees safe.

days.title: Breathe and stretch: a 10-minute flow
days.goal: Learn a slow stretch flow linked to breathing.

video.title: Fix Your Stiff Hips

steps: Breathe in as you reach your arms up.
Breathe out as you fold forward.
Breathe in as you come up.
Move slowly, one breath per move.
Do 5 rounds.
End sitting quietly for 1 minute.
days.task: Do the 10-minute breathing flow today.
days.challenge: Do the flow every morning this week.

options: Slow moves linked to your breathing
quiz.explain: A flow links movement and breath.
One breath per move keeps the flow slow and calm.
Quiet sitting settles the body and mind.

days.title: Get ready for your capstone
days.goal: Review the whole course and prepare your final routine.

video.title: Feel Looser & Improve Hip Mobility in Bed

steps: Read your notes from weeks 1 to 4.
List 5 moves you can now do well.
Practise your capstone routine once.
Write down any questions you still have.
days.task: List 5 moves you can do well now.
days.challenge: Do your capstone routine from memory.

options: A final routine that shows what you learned
quiz.explain: The capstone is your final show of skill.

quiz.q: What should you review before the capstone?
options: Your notes from all four weeks
quiz.explain: Reviewing all weeks brings the course together.

quiz.q: How do you know you are ready?
options: You can do a full routine smoothly from memory
quiz.explain: A smooth routine shows you are ready.

days.title: Final practice day
days.goal: Practise your capstone once more, then rest.

video.title: Start Here: Complete 30 Minute Beginner Mobility (WIth Coaching)

steps: Do your capstone routine one more time.
Check your breathing and your form.
Fix anything that felt rushed.
Rest well tonight.
days.task: Do your capstone routine and time it.
days.challenge: Fix one thing that felt rushed.

options: Practice makes the real run calm and smooth
quiz.explain: Practice turns worry into calm confidence.

quiz.q: What should you check after practice?
options: Your form, your breathing and your timing
quiz.explain: Checking form and timing makes it smooth.

quiz.q: What should you do the night before?
quiz.explain: Good rest helps you do your best.

days.title: Capstone day: your mobility routine
days.goal: Show what you learned: lead your full mobility routine.

video.title: 15 Moves to Replace Your ENTIRE Mobility Routine

steps: Warm up your joints for 5 minutes.
Do your full routine: neck, shoulders, chest, hips, legs.
End with slow breathing for 1 minute.
Write a short report on how it went.
days.task: Lead your capstone routine and write your report.
days.challenge: Hand in your report and celebrate.

quiz.q: What is the first step of your routine?
quiz.explain: A warm-up wakes the joints up.

quiz.q: What matters most in the routine?
options: Going as fast as you can
Smooth moves, gentle stretches and slow breathing
quiz.explain: Smooth, gentle moves show real skill.

options: What you did and how it felt
quiz.explain: A short report shows what you learned.

capstone.title: Your mobility routine
capstone.brief: Lead your full mobility routine: a 5-minute joint warm-up, stretches for neck, shoulders, chest, hips and legs, and 1 minute of slow breathing, and write a short report.
deliverables: A short video or notes from the routine
